scripts.edge:check: npm run edge:type-check && npm run edge:lint
scripts.py:lint: uvx ruff@0.15.8 check scraper github_stats supabase_stats supabase_app pipeline_meta mcp dashboard scripts
scripts.py:format-check: uvx ruff@0.15.8 format --check scraper github_stats supabase_stats supabase_app pipeline_meta mcp dashboard scripts
scripts.py:security: uvx bandit -r scraper github_stats supabase_stats supabase_app pipeline_meta mcp dashboard scripts -x mcp/.venv --severity-level high --confidence-level high
scripts.py:check: npm run py:lint && npm run py:format-check && npm run py:type-check && npm run py:security
scripts.actions:check: npm run actions:lint && npm run actions:security:ratchet && npm run shell:lint
scripts.ty:ratchet: for p in scraper github_stats supabase_stats supabase_app pipeline_meta mcp dashboard; do bash scripts/ty-ratchet.sh $p 0 || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:vitest && npm run test:e2e
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
